text: How to Make a Paper Airplane. Take a sheet of paper and fold it in half the long way. Open it again. Fold the top two corners down to the middle line. Fold the new edges to the middle line again. Fold the plane in half. Then fold each wing down. Hold it under the wings and throw it gently forward. Try again if it falls fast.

How to Wash Your Hands. Turn on the water and wet your hands. Put soap on your hands. Rub them together for twenty seconds. Do not forget the backs of your hands, between your fingers and under your nails. Rinse the soap off with clean water. Dry your hands with a clean towel. Washing your hands helps stop germs from spreading.

How to Plant a Tree. Pick a spot with enough sun and space. Dig a hole that is two times as wide as the roots. Put the tree in the hole so it stands straight. Fill the hole with soil and press it down. Give the tree a lot of water. Keep watering it every week during the first summer.

How to Pack a School Bag. Check your class list for the next day. Put your books in first, the big ones at the back. Add your pencil case and your homework folder. Pack your lunch and a bottle of water. Make sure the bag is not too heavy. Leave it by the door so you do not forget it in the morning.

How to Take Care of a Fish. Get a tank that is big enough for your fish. Fill it with clean water that is not too cold. Feed your fish a small pinch of food once or twice a day. Do not give it too much food. Clean the tank every week. Watch your fish to make sure it swims well and looks healthy.

How to Make a Fruit Salad. Wash all your fruit first. Cut apples, bananas and oranges into small pieces. Add some grapes and berries. Put everything in a big bowl. Squeeze a little lemon juice on top so the apples stay fresh. Mix it gently with a spoon. Keep it cold until you are ready to eat.
